verdict.rationale: Mercury is a hosted banking service, and the evidence never says the core platform's source is published. Only peripheral client tooling is on public GitHub repos: the Go SDK (mercury-go), the agent skills directory (mercury-skills) and the CLI (mercury-cli). None of these items states an open-source license. Missing for 10: any open license on the published repos, public source for the core product, and independent confirmation that the repos are openly licensed.
